main_visual_task: A quiet girl in a red tee holds a flower bouquet inside a vast red-glowing stadium crowd; a single moving spotlight finds her, walks her down the passage toward the stage, and ends looking up at the singer turning toward her from the stage edge.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same young Chinese woman from the reference photo: soft oval face, fair skin, thin round metal-frame glasses, dark brown mid-parted hair past her shoulders, matte red-brown lips; she wears a loose bright-red long-sleeve tee and a fine necklace; she carries one wrapped flower bouquet (red roses, kraft-paper wrap)
prompt_bible.environment_lock: night open-air stadium concert, ocean of red glow sticks held by a blurred crowd (crowd never resolves into clear faces), giant curved LED screen far background, stage on frame right; then a dark side passage with red light strips; then the stage-edge stairs
prompt_bible.material_lock: real skin pores with a faint sweat sheen, kraft paper crinkle of the bouquet wrap, rose petals with true velvet texture, volume haze in the beams, cotton tee weave; physically plausible contact and gravity
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: one spotlight-language world: distant stage light dominates A1-A2, one real moving follow-spot sweeps the stands and locks on her in A3 and brightens step by step until A5; red ambient under-glow everywhere; shadows obey the follow-spot
prompt_bible.palette_lock: deep night blue-black base, ember red (glow sea, bouquet, tee, screen), warm skin highlights, cool silver on the singer's hair
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm cinema camera, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, restrained handheld breathing only in the passage walk
prompt_bible.screen_direction: she travels left to right across the whole segment; the stage and the singer always hold frame-right weight
prompt_bible.audio_policy: no dialogue; distant concert roar, glow-stick rhythm, paper crinkle, one deep breath, rising crowd swell on the spotlight find; exact sound mix in post
